items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Nipsy Russell and Billy Daniels and everybody played there, didn't they. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that was a good place.

ctx.x: Right at the corner of one of those -- of St. Nicholas, I think.
That's right, it was near -- on 125th Street near St. Nicholas. Nipsy Russell and Billy Daniels and everybody played there, didn't they. Even Pearl Bailey played there one time, didn't she.
Yeah, that was a good place.
